frame_and_rails.normalization: unit(x)=x/||x||; refuse zero/nonfinite vector, no fallback
frame_and_rails.proximal_station: Q0=P0-0.040*A; Q1=P1; Q2=P2. This original deliberate proximal extension is untested, not source clearance or fixed-recipe correction.
frame_and_rails.node_frame: At each i, U_i=unit((0,-1,0)-dot((0,-1,0),N_i)*N_i); V_i=cross(N_i,U_i). (U,V,N) is the new declared proper computational frame. Require dot(V_i,(0,0,1)) has the side upper sign; refuse disagreement. Upper direction W_i=side_sign*V_i. Original signed source basis remains untouched; no inherited body sample phase.
frame_and_rails.rail_knots: For each independent layer profile: F_i=Q_i+front_width[i]*U_i; R_i=Q_i-back_width[i]*U_i. These are original seam knots, not body-course vertices.
frame_and_rails.rail_curve: F(s) and R(s) each have two cubic Hermite spans: H(q;P0,P1,D0,D1) for0<=s<=0.5,q=2s; H(q;P1,P2,D1,D2) for0.5<=s<=1,q=2s-1. Each uses its own F_i or R_i knots and the shared D_i.
frame_and_rails.C1_scope: Exact shared knot/D1 and equal half-length parameter spans prove C1 only along each longitudinal rail at s=0.5. No global surface/seam derivative/Jacobian claim.

arches.upper_proximal_and_wrist: At node i=0 or2 use C0=F_i,C3=R_i,C1=F_i+(R_i-F_i)/3+h_upper*W_i,C2=R_i-(R_i-F_i)/3+h_upper*W_i. Heights are handle values, not realised maximum bulge.
arches.source_relative_opening: Both layer wrist arches lie in the declared Q2/body-cuff reference plane by frame orthogonality. Actual usable aperture, O/I separation, containment and fit remain untested. Inner profile is independently authored, not a normal offset or automatic body-copy.

surfaces.Blend: (1-t)*L(s)+t*R(s)+(1-s)*Cap(t)+s*Wrist(t)-[(1-s)*(1-t)*P00+s*(1-t)*P10+(1-s)*t*P01+s*t*P11]; P00=L(0)=Cap(0),P10=L(1)=Wrist(0),P01=R(0)=Cap(1),P11=R(1)=Wrist(1). Exact shared endpoints are authoritative. Ordinary four-boundary blend; no upstream novelty/equivalence claim.

future_mesh_requirements.mandatory: s=0,.5,1; t=0,1. Equal shared source curve evaluations use canonical owners, exact endpoint values; one F32cast after all source evaluations.

qualification.source_preservation: Exact qualified body/archive/native-source owners, helpers, masks, keys, rig/rest/pose and materials unchanged. No mask/cut/body/ease/control tuning to hide failures.
qualification.full_contact: All source26756triangles vs every O/I/rim material triangle. All material self/lining pairs retain actual incidence ownership. Proper transverse or nonpermitted coplanar overlap refuses; boundary/degenerate/numerical/budget uncertainty is UNKNOWN. No adjacency class discarded wholesale.
qualification.interior_enclosure: Diagnostic free-space enclosure uses inner sleeve surfaces with their own outward orientation and separately owned planar proximal/wrist closures, not material caps. Must prove closed connected oriented manifold/simple non-self-intersecting realised mesh before solid classification. Diagnostic caps alone prove nothing.
qualification.fullsurface_coverage: For every clipped body piece, prove no enclosure-boundary intersection and strict representative classification; use that connected-piece disjointness only after enclosure prerequisites, retain exact plane-boundary ownership. Interior enclosure for required; outer enclosure for exposed. Tangency/cap/boundary/classification ambiguity UNKNOWN. No centroid-only pass.
qualification.solid_rules: Candidate enclosure topology/whole intersection and reproducible parity/degree agreement required; sourcebody solid occupancy not assumed. Numerical/scope/budget unresolved duties retain UNKNOWN and no fit acceptance.
qualification.actual_images: Fresh separately admitted first front/oblique/rear on unchanged actor, all geometry framed and explicit prototype/refusal labels; root+critic whole originals decide appearance. No current renderer/material/capture tuning.
qualification.pose_and_integration: Only unchanged neutral source is nominated. Torso/armhole connection, rig weights, body morph transfer, posed-body/garment evidence and all-motion qualification are HELD; parenting or source stations do not discharge them.
qualification.success_limit: At most standalone neutral-sleeve source/discrete/static qualification; never accepted wearable jacket, body-range, moving avatar, finished cuff/lining/material/UV/export/runtime/AAA claim.
qualification.cut_boundary_scope: The cuff-plane equality belongs required and remains explicit source interface ownership. Any intersection with diagnostic enclosure caps is evaluated as its own cut-boundary/aperture obligation; do not discard it as harmless or infer coverage from centroid classification. If complete boundary inclusion cannot be certified, fullsurface coverage remains UNKNOWN and no static physical-fit acceptance follows.
qualification.nested_enclosures: Inner enclosure must independently be contained inside outer enclosure with no unowned boundary/material intersections before using outer-envelope exposure reasoning. Positive profile differences alone do not prove nesting.

first_missing_integration: An independently authored connected torso/armhole boundary and complete source-relative integration mapping are absent. This is held before any wearable-jacket constructor; source sleeve responsibility may be reviewed without pretending integration exists.
